title: Thai-Style Steamed Fish Wrap
description: A flavorful and refreshing Thai-inspired dish featuring steamed fish wrapped in a fragrant Saudi Arabian-style flatbread.
instructions: Steam the swordfish fillet for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the Saudi Arabian flatbread in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes on each side.
In a small bowl, mix together chili sauce and soy sauce.
Once the swordfish is cooked, place it on the toasted flatbread and brush with the chili-soy mixture.
Garnish with tobiko, chopped Thai basil, sliced cucumber, and sliced carrots.
Serve immediately with a lime wedge on the side.
To assemble the wrap, place the swordfish mixture on the flatbread and fold the wrap in half.
